name: weekly-changelog
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：weekly-changelog。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Generate a weekly changelog markdown file summarizing external API and feature changes from git commits in a date range. Extracts before/after Python examples per commit, groups by theme (DSL / distributed / runtime / IR deprecations), and attributes each change to its author. Use when the user asks for a weekly report, changelog, commit summary, or interface-change digest.
